# Coursicle

> Coursicle is an all-in-one student platform for tracking assignments, planning schedules, reading professor reviews, and managing academics across multiple institutions.

Coursicle serves students across universities and vocational schools in the San Jose area and beyond, offering integrated tools for course scheduling, class management, and peer communication through its built-in chat feature. The platform supports both traditional universities like San Jose State University and Santa Clara University, as well as specialized institutions ranging from medical and business schools to beauty and barber colleges.

## Key Topics

- Class tracking
- Course scheduling
- Schedule management
- Student platform
- Coursicle Chat
- Premium subscription
- Schedule sharing
- Course management
- Student tools
- Chat feature
- San Jose State University
- Santa Clara University
- Academic planning
- Student collaboration

## Main Platform

- [Coursicle | All your academics, all in one place](https://www.coursicle.com): Coursicle homepage: track assignments, plan schedules, read professor reviews
